player_prompt.intro:
Nawe ngumdlali {player_id} emdlalweni we-Kuhn Poker we-{max_rounds}.
Imithetho yeMdlalo:
- I-Kuhn Poker isebenzisa dekhi ye-3 yemakadi eJ, Q, K (iJ iyona ifuphi, iK iyona iphakeme)
- Ngemdlalo ngamunye kubetwa {ante} chip futsi umdlali anikwe kadi 1 (kumbula kutsi makadi ayahlukaniswa, ngako-ke awukwati kuwa na kadi lefanana na leyomgadli wakho).
- Mdlalo uyaqhubeka kuze kube {max_rounds} rounds
- Umdlali lonemali eningi emvakwe kugcina kwemdlalo wona
Imithetho yeNchukumo:
- '[check]': Dlula ngaphandle kubeta (nje kuphela uma kungekho beti etafileni)
- '[bet]': Ongeza 1 chip ku-pot (nje kuphela uma kungekho beti etafileni)
- '[call]': Lingana na beti ya mgadli wakho ongeza 1 chip ku-pot
- '[fold]': Beka isandla lakho futsi uyivumele mgadli wakho atfole i-pot

init_round.round_start: ### Kusuka round {current_round} kwezinto {max_rounds} zezinga. Ikadi yakho ni: '{player_card}'

showdown.showdown_summary: Showdown: Kadi ya Umdlali {winner} {winner_card} ina tsandza kadi ya Umdlali {loser} {loser_card}. Umdlali {winner} utsandze i-pot ye-{pot_value} chips.

outcome.draw: Ekupheleni kwemijikelo {max_rounds}, bobabili labadlali bebaphetse linani lelilinganako lemasheke.
